draft.emotion: a bit bashful and hesitant, slightly avoiding eye contact
notes: Used with 'estar' or 'ficar' (never 'ser') to describe a temporary feeling: 'estar com vergonha' (to feel shy/embarrassed), 'ficar com vergonha' (to get shy/embarrassed). For a permanent personality trait, use 'tímido' (shy).
Followed by 'de' + infinitive or noun to name the cause: 'com vergonha de falar' (too shy to speak).

senses.definition: Feeling ashamed or uncomfortable because of an action or situation.

examples.text: Fiquei com vergonha do que eu disse na reunião.
examples.translation: I felt embarrassed about what I said at the meeting.
examples.emotion: regretful and hoping to move past the awkward moment

draftBefore.emotion: a bit bashful and hesitant, slightly avoiding eye contact
notes: Use 'com vergonha' to describe a person who feels shy or embarrassed. It is much more common than the single-word adjective 'envergonhado'.
It is also frequently used to say that someone is 'shy' of doing something, as in 'ele está com vergonha de falar' (he is too shy to speak).
